items.text: Clean up the trash at the side of the house and in the backyard.
items.priceBasis: Est. 45 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $27. Walk the side yard and backyard picking up scattered trash and the pile along the wall.

items.text: Take the trash can out to the curb. Fill it no more than 3/4 full — the city won't take it if it's overflowing or too heavy.
items.priceBasis: Est. 8 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $5. Redistribute so the can is no more than 3/4 full, then wheel it to the curb.

items.text: Bag up the leftover trash and haul it off-site. About 2–3 bags.
items.priceBasis: Est. 25 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $15 for bagging and loading 2-3 bags. The drive to dump them is not billed separately - it is inside the day rate. Material is a box of contractor bags.

items.text: Replace the blinking light fixture. Get one that takes a replaceable bulb — matte black preferred.
items.priceBasis: Est. 35 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $21. Kill power, pull the old fixture, wire and mount the new one. Material is a basic matte black fixture; your past matte fixtures ran about $31 each.

items.text: Secure the curtain rods. Anchor into the studs — the curtains are heavy.
items.priceBasis: Est. 30 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $18 - two rods at ~15 min each to find studs, re-mount the brackets and patch the old holes. Material is anchors and screws.

items.text: Install 4 recessed lights, evenly spaced. Exact placement is flexible, just keep them equal distance.
items.priceBasis: Est. 5.5 hr at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $197 - about 75 min per light to cut, fish, wire and mount, plus 30 min laying out the spacing. Your past 'Install 4 recessed lights in the living room' job was $250 labor, but that one also included a dimmer switch.

items.text: Replace the closet lock with a keypad lock you punch a code into.
items.priceBasis: Est. 45 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $27, including boring the new door for the lockset. Material left blank - keypad locks run $40 to $200 depending on the grade you want.

items.text: Replace the closet door with a solid core door.
items.priceBasis: Est. 2 hr at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $72. Solid core slabs are heavy and need fitting - pull the old door, mortise the hinges, plane to fit, hang and test. Material left blank - depends on the door size and whether you want a slab or prehung.

items.text: Install a door stop so the new closet door doesn't get damaged.
items.priceBasis: Est. 10 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $6. Drill and screw in a baseboard door stop.

items.text: Make the cedar closet door open, close, and latch smoothly. It should not catch anywhere.
items.priceBasis: Est. 70 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $42. Plane the edge that is catching, adjust the hinges, reset the strike plate, test. Your past 'Repair the door so it latches and opens and closes smoothly' was $50 labor.

items.text: Remove the carpet from underneath the sofa, roll it up, and put it in the garage.
items.priceBasis: Est. 30 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $18. Move the sectional and coffee table off, roll the rug, carry it to the garage, put the furniture back. Nothing to buy.

items.text: Make the hallway light work. Most likely needs a new light fixture.
items.priceBasis: Est. 40 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $24 to diagnose bulb, then fixture, then switch, and swap the fixture. Material is a basic flush mount - less if it turns out to be only a bulb.

Est. 60 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $36. The photo shows a surface-mount cabinet, so it is unscrew, remove, level and remount. Material left blank - cabinets run $60 to $250 and you may want to pick the size and style.

items.text: Tighten the globe on the ceiling light, or replace the light fixture, so the globe doesn't look like it's falling out.
items.priceBasis: Est. 15 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $9 to tighten the globe thumbscrews, which is the caption's first choice. If the fixture has to be replaced instead, closer to 35 min/$21 plus about $50 for the fixture.

items.text: Install brackets so the dresser mirror does not move.
items.priceBasis: Est. 25 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $15. Find the studs and screw in mirror brackets. Material anchored to your past 'Secure the laundry tub so that it does not move' at $25.
